InstanceVersionUpgrade.kernelVersion: Version number for major version upgrades. Empty for non-major version upgrades. <li>The target version must be higher than the current version. <li>Standard version 3.x can be upgraded to 6.x or 7.x <li>4.x can be upgraded to 6.x or 7.x <li>5.x can be upgraded to 6.x or 7.x <li>6.x can be upgraded to 7.x
InstanceVersionUpgrade.isDefer: Execution time. <li>false: execute immediately <li>true: execute during the maintenance window
